title: Assign Cookies
statement: `g[i]` is the minimum cookie size child i accepts. `s[j]` is the size of cookie j. Each child gets at most one cookie. Return the maximum number of content children.
hints: Give the smallest cookie that satisfies the smallest remaining child.
If the cookie is too small, discard it. If it fits, move to the next child.
editorial: Sorting both sides makes the greedy choice local. A cookie that cannot satisfy the smallest child cannot satisfy any later child, so it is discarded. A cookie that can satisfy the child is assigned immediately, because saving it cannot help a smaller child and a larger child can still use a larger cookie.
reference_solution:
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
from collections import Counter, OrderedDict, defaultdict, deque
import heapq

def find_content_children(g: list[int], s: list[int]) -> int:
    g.sort()
    s.sort()
    child = cookie = 0
    while child < len(g) and cookie < len(s):
        if s[cookie] >= g[child]:
            child += 1
        cookie += 1
    return child
